name: MZR Buy X Pay Y
author: Meshut Digital

sections.description:
MZR Buy X Pay Y is a simple yet powerful WooCommerce plugin that allows you to set up flexible “Buy X Get Y Free” or “Buy X Pay Y” discounts for your customers. Encourage sales, move inventory faster, and improve your store’s conversion rate effortlessly.

Key Features:

🔥 Fully Customizable Buy X Pay Y Promotions
– Set X (number of products to buy) and Y (number of products to pay for).
– Supports any combination, e.g., Buy 3 Pay 2, Buy 5 Pay 3, etc.

🎯 Product & Category Inclusion/Exclusion
– Apply discounts to specific products or product categories.
– Exclude products or categories you don’t want to include in the promotion.

📅 Schedule Promotions
– Define start and end dates with precise time control.
– Run limited-time offers or ongoing promotions.

📝 Custom Discount Labels & Descriptions
– Customize the label shown in the cart (e.g., “Special Offer: Buy 3 Pay 2”).
– Optionally display a detailed description below the cart totals.

⚙️ No Coupons Needed
– Discount is applied automatically in the cart, no manual coupon entry.

🚀 Lightweight & Fast
– No bloat, clean code optimized for performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mzr-buy-x-pay-y directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → General → Buy X Pay Y tab to configure your discount rules.
sections.faq:
Can I set different Buy X Pay Y rules for different categories or products?

Currently, the plugin applies one rule globally but allows you to include or exclude specific categories and products to fine-tune where the discount applies.

Does the plugin automatically apply the discount in the cart?

Yes, there is no need for customers to enter a coupon code. The discount is applied automatically if conditions are met.

Can I set start and end dates for promotions?

Absolutely! You can easily set a promotion period using the built-in date & time settings.

Does it support variable products?

Yes! The plugin works with both simple and variable products.
